biteOfDay: Trout on Taneycomo are responding well to light presentations in the low morning flows. Stocked rainbows and holdover browns are active in the clear, cold tailwater. On Table Rock, bass are holding tighter to deeper structure and points as water cools.
tip: Insider tip: In the low morning flows on Taneycomo, drift or wade with a 1/16-oz micro jig (brown, black, or sculpin) or a zebra midge under an indicator.
